scope: Bounded receive-parser classification on the dedicated Intel Sonoff testbed; no pairing or control in this sample
operator: Linux specialist; sole existing UART owner retained

capture.method: Installed strace observes only reads from the selected serial device path in the existing owner; no independent serial reader
capture.elapsed_scope: Instrumentation wrapper elapsed time, including post-capture inspection; not an exact tracer attach-to-detach duration
capture.exit_explanation: Deliberate SIGINT to tracer only; detached cleanly
capture.timing_limit: Tracing perturbs process scheduling; not RF or UART latency evidence

supported_ec_network_comparison.basis: Linux compared captured packets offline against the selected test network identity retained from the 2026-11-08 setup

source_interpretation.host: Service.handle_rx increments invalid_rx both for rx_envelope failures and for protocol.decode rejection. All sampled rejections take the unsupported-length branch; accepted EC frames pass their application checksum.
source_interpretation.firmware: MG21 receives standard IEEE 802.15.4 frames promiscuously, accepts successful radio packets, and exports MAC bytes with PHY header and hardware FCS removed.
source_interpretation.mac_classification_limit: ACK, data-request and other-data labels are inferred from captured FCF, length and command fields; they are not an independent over-the-air FCS check.
source_interpretation.conclusion: Unsupported non-EC receive traffic accounts for the entire sampled invalid_rx increase. No parser acceptance defect or transport corruption is demonstrated by this sample.
source_interpretation.recommendation: Keep frame acceptance, firmware, query timing and retries unchanged; proceed with separately confirmed bench pairing. A separately reviewed additive diagnostic-counter split distinguishes unsupported traffic from malformed/checksum failures; it was not present in the captured f48cf42 runtime.

limitations: The size-bounded trace does not classify the historical counter value of 252 or the entire accumulated count.
The API snapshot boundaries and trace boundaries are not atomically synchronized, despite equal observed rejection totals.
Hardware FCS bytes are absent; no independent radio-FCS verification or application decryption of other data frames was performed.
A syntactically recognized first record does not independently prove capture started exactly at a UART line boundary.
No conclusion about RF collision rate, end-to-end latency, pairing, switch control or long-term reliability follows from this sample.
Raw RF payloads, device identities and full trace remain private. Production HA and other radios were not operated.
